title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Database exports are now significantly faster and more reliable
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces significantly faster and more reliable database exports with failure rates below 1% for large environments. The dedicated Export History page is replaced with tracking via the Operations page, and administrators should migrate APIs to use the environment Operations endpoints.
key_points: Database exports are now significantly faster and more reliable with failure rates below 1%
Export History page is being removed; export progress tracking moves to the Operations page
Admin Center APIs for export history must migrate to environment Operations endpoints
BACPAC files are exported to Azure storage containers via Admin Center

quotes.text: database exports are now significantly faster and more reliable, with a failure rate below 1%
quotes.why_it_matters: This shows the key improvement that directly impacts administrators managing SaaS environments

quotes.text: export progress can now be tracked from the Operations page, alongside other environment operations
quotes.why_it_matters: This indicates the architectural change admins need to adopt for monitoring exports

quotes.text: If you're using Admin Center APIs to get database export history, please migrate to the environment Operations endpoints instead
quotes.why_it_matters: This is an actionable requirement for API users to update their integration code
